blind.description: A stylized wooden raised pulpit featuring an octagonal elevated enclosure with inset green and maroon panels and an angled book rest on the rim. A short curved staircase with handrails wraps around the side to provide access to the platform, and the main structure is supported by a thick central turned pedestal on a matching octagonal base. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and finished in a hand-painted wood style.
blind.from_above: An octagonal wooden cup-like enclosure with an interior wooden floor, an angled rectangular book rest on the left edge, and a small flight of stairs curving down to the lower right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 ft tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide across the base and stairs.
